summary: Woman hiking in the Crystal Lakes subdivision near Red Feather Lakes was knocked over by a bull moose around 2 p.m.; moose showed no aggression and did not trample her. Airlifted to a hospital due to the remoteness of the area; condition unknown.
location: Crystal Lakes subdivision, near Red Feather Lakes
responding_agency: Colorado Parks and Wildlife, air ambulance
notes: CPW: first moose-human encounter in Northern Colorado in 2026; no dogs present
